title: NMEA0183: Message Consolidation
description:
Consolidating a very large if/else block
to make the code more concise and readable.
Also migrating dissection to leverage
alphabetical ordering on parametric values
for binary search to improve performance.

AI-Assisted: Yes (ChatGPT and Codex)

notes.body: As discussed together, it might be even more efficient to convert the 3 character long string to a uint32_t so as to do an integer comparison instead of multiple strings comparisons.

I guess you could use the already fetched sentence_id instead of fetching again. BTW we do have some helper function allowing you to not reinvent wheel (convert_string_case() and convert_string_to_hex() in epan/strutil.h) but convert_string_to_hex() mandates to call g_free() afterward.

I can't use `convert_string_to_hex()` because it's only set up to handle hexadecimal ASCII characters with optional separator characters (e.g., `:`).

`convert_string_case()` allocates a new string in memory that has to be freed whereas `g_ascii_toupper()` takes one character and returns one character without any memory allocation.

I modified the ID handling logic to only perform the access once then index into the string.
